transition-ph1: Twelve projects (5.8 GW, 4.2 GW NRIS) on the Navajo South 500 kV system needed only modest shared work: Eldorado series caps, Yavapai 500/230 kV transformer replacement and a reactor relocation ($24M). Most cost is station work at each POI.
transition-ph2: Q274, Q370, Q458 and Q525 moved to ERIS, cutting NRIS to 2.35 GW. Only the Yavapai transformer replacement and reactor relocation remain ($15M).
cluster-2026: Q622 and Q623 (1,000 MW NRIS each) at Cedar Mountain and the Moenkopi–El Dorado 500 kV line, no results yet. The 2024 and 2025 clusters each had a single 161 MW project at Rabbit Canyon with no system upgrades.
